_comment: Phase-1 recollection using the serialization-controlled identity-order Parquet also used as the control in the order-sensitivity phase. The query definitions, four-worker policy, one warm-up, and ten measured runs per query are unchanged from the initial protocol.

runs.cache_policy: cold (fresh, isolated Playwright browser context per run — no shared HTTP cache, no persisted storage)

thresholds._comment: theta (fidelity/stability threshold), k (persistence length in consecutive frames), matching eq:stable-run in the paper.
